title: 序章21 接触序章22 贵族派系
content_zh:
多罗文斯，一个看起来风光的家族。
当代家主，马格尔·多罗文斯，曾经在黑蔷薇监狱演讲的那位。
贵为王爵，比起一般大公、公爵还要更高一阶的存在，仅次于当今皇室。
可这么一个家主，却只诞下了三名子嗣。
小女儿，伯爵，玛丽·多罗文斯。
二哥，伯爵，凯斯·多罗文斯。
大哥，侯爵，凯特·多罗文斯。
这在马尔提雅这种较为“开放”
的国家，是十分罕见的，也是致命的弱点。
不过作为距离皇帝最近的家族，这样的情况却是最容易被接受的，不如说皇帝希望王爵们都这么做。
所以，多罗文斯家族，因为子嗣少的原因，在众多王爵、公爵中，也被默认为了亲皇派、保皇派。
可哪怕子嗣数量少了，子嗣内部的关系依旧不好。
大哥常年在外，为了稳定爵位，参军谋取军功，可两三纪没回来了（1纪约6地球年），据说已经死于边疆。
父亲年迈愈发。
可妹妹的魔法天赋过于优秀，自认是第一继承人的二哥心生嫌隙。
在妹妹还小的时候，就百般刁难、欺凌。
养成了玛丽如今这副暴饮暴食、神色淡漠的形象。
这样下去肯定是不行的，否则本该属于玛丽的那一份遗产，也会被二哥凯斯夺走。
可，不论管家如何焦急，玛丽始终是一副事不关己，只知暴食的样子。
很快。

约定的日子就要到来了。
马斯尔能够作为城堡的守卫，本身还是有一定能说上话的机会的。
黎木作为贵奴，比起一般的奴隶，还有着一层特殊的意味。
很顺利的，黎木就成功获得了“侍奉”
玛丽的机会。
这一次的侍奉，一共挑选了8名男性。
全都是长相姣好的男性。
这些人说实话，长得都不差，如果有地球那些包装公司帮忙，不谈男神，也是个所谓小鲜肉。
可惜，他们的生活水平太差了，皮肤、身高、气质，在黎木面前还是差了一截。
城堡侧门前。
“进去后注意点。”
黎木身后传来了马斯尔的声音。
黎木认真点了点头。
要说不紧张是不可能的。
只要脖子上有项圈，就随时可能失身，甚至遭受到不可挽回的损伤。
很快。
一排婢女走来，领着8人走进了城堡。
余光中，黎木还瞥见了远处迪克从地下室探出的半个脑袋。
心中默默叹息，跟了进去。
content_en:
Dorovens, a seemingly prosperous family.
The current head of the family, Magol Dorovens, was the one who once gave a speech in Black Rose Prison.
As a prince, he is a higher-level existence than ordinary grand dukes and dukes, second only to the current royal family.
But such a family head only gave birth to three children.
Younger daughter, Earl, Mary Dorovens.
Second brother, Earl Keith Dorowens.
Eldest brother, Marquess, Kate Dorovens.
This is more "open" in Maltiya
The country is very rare and has a fatal weakness.
However, as the family closest to the emperor, this situation is the easiest to accept. It is better to say that the emperor hopes that all the princes will do this.
Therefore, the Dorovens family, among the many princes and dukes, was considered pro-royal and royalist by default because of their few heirs.
But even if the number of heirs is reduced, the relationship within the heirs is still not good.
The eldest brother was away from home all year round. In order to stabilize his title, he joined the army to seek military glory, but he did not come back for two or three centuries (about 6 Earth years in the 1st century). It is said that he died on the border.
My father is getting older.
But the sister's magic talent is too good, and the second brother, who considers himself the first heir, feels resentment.
When my sister was still young, she made things difficult and bullied her in every possible way.
This has created Mary's current image of overeating and indifferent expression.
It is definitely not possible to continue like this, otherwise the inheritance that should belong to Mary will also be taken away by her second brother Keith.
However, no matter how anxious the housekeeper was, Mary always looked like she had nothing to do with herself and only cared about gluttony.
soon.
The appointed day is coming.
Masr can serve as the guard of the castle, so he still has a chance to speak.
As a noble slave, Li Mu has a special meaning compared to ordinary slaves.
Very smoothly, Li Mu successfully obtained "service"
Mary's chance.
A total of 8 men were selected for this service.
All are good-looking men.
To be honest, these people are not bad looking. If the packaging companies on earth help, they will be so-called little fresh meat, not to mention male idols.
It's a pity that their living standards are so poor. Their skin, height, and temperament are still far behind Li Mu.
In front of the castle side gate.
"Be careful when you go in."
Maser's voice came from behind Li Mu.
Li Mu nodded seriously.
It's impossible to say I'm not nervous.
As long as there is a collar around your neck, you may lose your virginity at any time, or even suffer irreparable damage.
soon.
A row of maids came and led 8 people into the castle.
In his peripheral vision, Li Mu also caught a glimpse of Dick's half head poking out from the basement in the distance.
Sighing silently in his heart, he followed in.
